comps.label: C1
comps.reason: Homebuilder selling homes to retail buyers with mortgage and title arms; Forestar sells finished lots to builders.

comps.label: C2
comps.reason: Mainly a homebuilder selling to individual buyers; though it owns Forestar and develops lots, its business is homebuilding.

comps.label: C3
comps.reason: Homebuilder using optioned lots to build homes for retail buyers; it is a lot customer, not a lot developer.

comps.label: C4
comps.reason: Develops land into finished lots and sells some to third-party builders, though mainly a homebuilder; closest available overlap.

comps.label: C5
comps.reason: Production homebuilder selling to homebuyers with mortgage and title affiliates; not a lot developer.

comps.label: C6
comps.reason: Homebuilder using lot options and mortgage banking; buys lots rather than developing them for sale.
